author: sylntthunder
text:
Hey Pedini,

I wanted to ask you a question about order flow. This may be a loaded
question but it would really help me out being that it is one of the
last pieces of the puzzle for me. I have always had a problem with the
compartmentalizing of trades on a smaller TF and being an avid follower
of the Doctor, I've always wanted to gain the sensibility of order flow
in the macro sense. The thing that gets me everyday when I trade is
DIRECTION. The fractal nature of time makes this concept very difficult
 for me to grasp. Like what determines you direction for the day, the
daily curve, 4 hr, 1 hr?? I feel the direction is half the battle
because when working with smaller TF entries, you will get entry signals
 all over the place and if you are in a zone that is on the wrong side
of the curve, you will eventually blow an account by entering on the 15
min or 5 min because you probably will get some sort of a reversal
signal being that these entry TFs are so nimble compared to their larger
 TF zone counterparts. I guess what I'm trying to ask is how do you
spot the plausible reversal zones on the larger TFs (4hr, daily,
weekly)? Do you just go for extremities (from engulf to engulf) or
from fresh zone to fresh zone?? There have been many times where I
have seen a RBR or DBD get completely blown through on the 4hr or daily
even if an entry signal was given on the smaller TF because the trend
was so strong. Do you just depend on original DBR and RBD for macro
trend REVERSAL spots?? I just like the Idea of knowing my direction for
 the day and only taking longs or shorts for days weeks until the trend
is over, thus staying out of the cop of counter trend movements. Happy
belated B Day btw.

ST
